question: Identify the chemical formula of ammonium hydroxide.
solution:
The correct answer is __**NH₄OH**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **chemical formula** for **ammonium hydroxide **is** NH₄OH.**
 
• **Ammonium hydroxide** is a **colourless liquid with a strong, pungent odour.**
 
• It is made by dissolving ammonia gas in water, and the resulting solution contains around** 30-35% ammonia by weight.**
 
• **Uses:**
 
 
• **Ammonium hydroxide **is commonly used as a **cleaning agent in household and industrial applications.**
 
• It is an** effective degreaser** and can** help remove stains and dirt from surfaces.**
 
• Ammonium hydroxide is also used in the manufacturing of various products, such as **fertilizers, plastics, textiles, and pharmaceuticals.**
 
• It is used in the **food industry as a leavening agent and pH regulator.**
 
• It is sometimes used to adjust the** acidity of foods, such as baked goods and cheeses, and to prevent the browning of certain fruits and vegetables.**
 
• While ammonium hydroxide is** generally considered safe for its intended uses, it can be hazardous if mishandled or used improperly.**
 
• The fumes can be irritating to the** eyes, nose, and throat, and prolonged exposure can cause respiratory problems.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Important elements and their day-to-day uses:**

• **Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) -** Also known as baking soda, sodium bicarbonate is used as a leavening agent in baking, as well as for cleaning and deodorizing.
 
• **Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) - **Hydrogen peroxide is used as a disinfectant and for bleaching and whitening various materials, such as hair and teeth.
 
• **Ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃) -** Ammonium nitrate is used as a fertilizer in agriculture and as an ingredient in explosives.
 
• **Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) - **Ethanol is used as a fuel, a solvent, and as an ingredient in alcoholic beverages.
 
• **Acetic acid (CH3COOH) - **Acetic acid is used as a food preservative, as well as in the production of vinegar and other chemicals.
 
• **Sodium hypochlorite (NaClO) -** Sodium hypochlorite is used as a disinfectant and for bleaching various materials, such as textiles and paper products.
 
• **Citric acid (C₆H₈O₇) - **Citric acid is used as a food preservative and flavouring agent, as well as in cleaning products and pharmaceuticals.
 
• **Sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃) -** Also known as washing soda, sodium carbonate is used as a cleaning agent and water softener, as well as in the production of glass and other chemicals.
